Definition: from G4862 and ἀθροίζω (to hoard); to convene:--call (gather) together.
BiblicalUsage: After his escape Peter comes to the house of Mary the mother of John Mark, where many are gathered together praying, and at Ephesus Demetrius calls together the workmen of like occupation to defend their craft. One gathering prays and the other plots, and the same word covers both, because gathering is only as good as its purpose.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gathering together is powerful for good or for evil, and I believe a praying gathering is the safest place on earth.
